m: गोणा f. (Pāṇ. iv, 1, 42) a kind of grass, Gaṇar. 54
गोणाश्मन् m. a kind of gem, L.

s: strI, (SaRAdiguRAd jAtaH goRaH nipAtanAdukArasya guRaH । goRaSabdAt Avapane'rTe “jAnapadakuRqagoReti .” 4 । 1 । 42 । iti NIz .) DAnyAdivahanArTADAraviSezaH । iti mugDaboDam । guR iti BAzA ॥ droRIparimARam । iti vEdyakapariBAzA ॥ (yaTA, suSrute cikitsitasTAne caturTADyAye । “viqAlanakulozwrARAM carmmagoRyAM mfgasya vA । prabeSavedvA svaByaktaM SvAlvaRenopanAhitam ॥” “SUrpAByAYca BaveddroRI vAho goRI ca sA smftA । mAzawaNkAkzavilvAni kuqavaH prasTamAQakam । rASirgoRI KAriketi yaTottaracaturguRAH ॥” iti SArNgaDareRa pUrvvaKaRqe praTame'DyAya uktam ॥ “goRI SUrpadvayaM vidyAt KArIM BArIntaTEva ca । dvAtriMSataM vijAnIyAt vAhaM SUrpARi budDimAn ॥” iti kalpasTAne dvAdaSe'DyAye carakeRoktam ॥) Cidravastram । tatparyyAyaH । SAnI 2 । iti hemacandraH । 3 । 343 ॥
v: strI guRa--GaY ni॰ guRaH goRa + Avapane'rTe NIp । DAnyADAre (guRa) KyAte 1 AvapanapAtre 2 Cidravastre,3 SARyAM, 4 dviSUrpAtmake mAnaBede, 5 droRIparimARe ca । “goRI tvAvapanaM cet” smAnapadA॰ pA॰ sU॰ si॰ kO॰ । tasya dviSUrpAtmakatA BAvapra॰ uktA yaTA “SUrpAByAYca BaveddroRI vAho goRI ca sA smftA । droRIcatuzwayaM KArI kaTitA sUkzmabudDiBiH । catuHsahasrapalikA zaRRavatyaDikA va sA । palAnAM dvisahasraYca BAra ekaH prakIrttitaH । tulA palaSataM jYeyaM sarvatrEvEza niScayaH । mAzawaNkAkzavilvAni kuqavaH prasTa mAwakam । rASirgoRI svAriketi yaTottaracaturguRam” । paYcaBiH saptaBirvA goRIBiH krItaH tadDitArTe dvigO parimARAt WaY । “dvigorluganapatye” pA॰ tasya luki upavarjanastrIpratyayesya luk । tataH “idgoRyAH” pA॰ it paYcagoRi saptagoRi paYcagoRyAdikrIte pawAdO tri॰ । hrasvA goRI zwarac zittvAt NIz । goRItarI hrasvagoRyAm ।
m: गोणी f. (in Prākṛt) a cow, Pat. Introd. 35; 97; and on Vārtt. 6
a sack, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 42; Suśr.; Daś.; Śiś. xii, 10; ŚārṅgP.
a measure of 4 Droṇas, ŚārṅgS. i, 29
गोणी f. (ifc. after numerals ˚णि), Pāṇ. i, 2, 50, Kāś.
torn or ragged clothes, L. (cf. गौणिक.)
गोणी f. of ˚ण, q.v.
a: गोणी — 1 A sack. --2 A measure of capacity equal to a Droṇa. --3 Ragged garment, torn clothes.

m: गोणी—पथ N. of a man, Pravar. iii, 1.
गोणी—तरी f. a small sack, Pāṇ. v, 3, 90.
गोण m. (fr. Pāli and Prākṛt) an ox, SaddhP. iii; Hemac.
गोणिका f. (in Pāli goṇaka) a kind of woollen cloth, SaddhP. iii.
N. of the mother of Patañjali, IW. 167.
गोणिका—पुत्र m. N. of the author of a work on the relations towards the wives of others, Vātsyāy. i, 5, 5 and 35; v, 1, 8; 4, 26 and 33; 6, 48.
गोण्डा-क्री f. = ˚ड-किरी.

m: गोण्ड m. a fleshy navel, L.
a person with a fleshy or prominent navel, L.
a man of a low tribe, mountaineer, esp. inhabiting the eastern portion of the Vindhya range between the Narmadā and Kṛṣṇā.
गोण्ड—किरी f. (in music) N. of a Rāgiṇī (cf. गौण्ड-क्˚.)
गोण्ड—वार id.
गोण्ड—वन n. ‘Goṇḍa forest’, N. of a country.
